item.title: Police Funding, School Safety, Bahamian Film Nomination
item.ns0:title: Police Funding, School Safety, Bahamian Film Nomination
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, the United States government injects a major multi-million dollar boost of funding and equipment into the Royal Bahamas Police Force to modernize training and operations. As thousands of students prepare to return to classrooms in just a matter of hours, the teachers' union sounds the alarm over critical leadership vacancies while police issue urgent safety warnings for parents and motorists. We also take you to Long Island where officers are investigating a tragic late-night fatal road crash, and celebrate a milestone international nomination for a talented Bahamian filmmaker. Plus, we have your complete weekend sports wrap-up and a look at an unsettled weather forecast for the school week ahead, so tune in to get fully caught up!
